# Hillradar AI

> Hillradar AI (https://hillradar.com) is a public-records research tool that tracks the stock trades US senators and representatives are legally required to disclose under the STOCK Act. It turns Periodic Transaction Reports into a searchable database with lawmaker profiles, company views, activity clusters and alerts. It is independent, non-partisan, not affiliated with the US Government, and provides no financial advice.

## Key facts
- Coverage: every disclosed congressional stock trade since 2014 (57,000+ filings, 350+ lawmakers, 9,000+ companies and assets), refreshed several times a day.
- Sources: official House Clerk and Senate eFD disclosure filings via open datasets, plus the official congress-legislators directory for names, parties, chambers, states and photos.
- Amounts are the ranges lawmakers report (e.g. $15,001–$50,000); the law allows up to 45 days to file after a trade and late filings are marked.
- Plans: Free (last 30 days of filings, profiles, 1 watchlist item). Pro: $497 per year (full history, AI Scanning of activity clusters with plain-English reasons, Investment Plan back-test and calculator, Telegram/WhatsApp/email alerts, unlimited watchlist, CSV export). 14-day refund on a first Pro payment.
- Audience: journalists, researchers, voters, compliance teams and self-directed investors who want the primary source.
- Contact: info@hillradar.com
